baseline_models.focus_anchor: The emphatic possessive construction لَنَا governs the coordinated definite poles ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ and ٱلْأُولَىٰ, with the later pole named first.
baseline_models.mechanism: Later-than-first and beginning/precedence form an endpoint pair. Their reversed order prevents the first term from controlling the sequence and turns the pair into a merism for the whole temporal field under one possession.

activation_trace.role: Its later-or-other-than-first image supplies the terminal pole and opens the span beyond a single named realm.
Its beginning-and-precedence image supplies the initial pole, completing an all-time merism.

changed_reading.before: Two realms, the hereafter and the first life, are separately said to belong to God.
changed_reading.after: The reversed first/later endpoints claim every temporal position between origin and aftermath within one undivided possession.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus places the later term before ٱلْأُولَىٰ, whose dominant inventory also contains return to outcome rather than only firstness.
baseline_models.mechanism: A deferred phase is paired with a branch in which a thing returns, becomes, or reaches its outcome. The lexical order can therefore be carried as a loop from delay to eventual return, not only as two static epochs.

activation_trace.role: Its postponement-to-a-later-time image makes the first pole an interval of deferral.
Its return-to-outcome image converts the other pole into arrival at a resulting meaning or end.

changed_reading.before: First and last are opposite locations on a straight timeline.
changed_reading.after: What is deferred and what it finally returns or resolves into are both held; futurity is a governed return rather than an external territory.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possessive لَنَا is attached to ٱلْأُولَىٰ, whose split inventories preserve governance, charge, and superior entitlement alongside firstness.
baseline_models.mechanism: Possession is thickened into jurisdiction: setting affairs right, taking charge, and having the superior claim explain what it means for both temporal poles to be 'ours.' This coexists with, rather than replaces, the temporal merism.

activation_trace.role: Its later-than-first image fixes the farther phase over which charge extends.
Its governing-and-repairing image turns bare title into active ordering of affairs.
Its assuming-charge image supplies custodial authority to the possessive construction.
Its priority-and-superior-right image makes the claim one of rightful entitlement, not merely control.

changed_reading.before: The verse states static cosmic ownership.
changed_reading.after: The verse also asserts the rightful charge to order, sustain, and adjudicate both the first and later phases.

context_deltas.mechanism: Covering and disclosure recode temporal distance as visibility. The later pole can be absent or screened, while a branch of the first pole is a visible outline; both the hidden future and manifest edge remain within the same possessive field.

activation_trace.role: Its later-or-absent image supplies the temporally distant pole that can be experienced as hidden.
Its visible-outline image supplies the manifest edge opposed to temporal absence.
Its covering layer supplies the operation that renders a phase present but unseen.
Its uncovering-and-appearing image supplies the reverse operation by which an occluded phase becomes manifest.

structural_cues: 92:1 covers and 92:2 discloses, while 92:13 names the later pole before the first.
The night/day alternation supplies a reversible state change rather than two sealed domains.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies covering, disclosure, absence, and visible-outline branches; I infer that changing visibility models the relation between temporal poles, while a live alternative is that night/day only furnishes a broad totality analogy.

changed_reading.before: The later and first are only chronological regions.
changed_reading.after: They are also alternating regimes of hiddenness and manifestation, so invisibility does not mark anything as outside the stated possession.

context_deltas.mechanism: Divergent striving is followed by the same making-easy formula for opposed destinations. Against the focus inventory of governance and charge, ownership becomes route-management: chosen vectors remain distinct, yet each is made increasingly traversable within one jurisdiction.

activation_trace.role: Its ordering-and-repairing image supplies active management rather than inert possession.
Its taking-charge image makes both trajectories answerable to one administration.
Its purposeful-motion image supplies agents moving toward sought ends.
Its dispersion image splits the motion into genuinely different vectors.
Its opening into ease after difficulty supplies positive route-conditioning toward the easy destination.
The same opening-into-ease image, now governing the hard destination, makes tractability distinct from desirability.
Its twisting-and-complication image preserves the adverse character of the destination even as its route becomes easy to follow.

structural_cues: 92:5-10 presents mirrored behavioral chains with the identical فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ frame serving opposite destinations.
The focus follows the assertion that guidance is upon the speaker, linking jurisdiction to directional provision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies purposeful divergence and repeated easing toward opposed ends; I infer a feedback arrow in which practiced choice makes its own route more traversable under divine management, while the live alternative is a simpler promise of eventual recompense.

changed_reading.before: Both endpoints belong to one sovereign after agents independently reach them.
changed_reading.after: The claim includes administration of path-dependence itself: divergent striving is progressively routed without being collapsed into one outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: The failure of 'his wealth' at the fall is followed by guidance being 'upon us' and both temporal poles being 'ours.' The pronoun sequence makes private title fail exactly where divine title appears, while the prepositional shift from burden to possession frames sovereignty as carrying a directional duty.

activation_trace.role: Its governance-and-repair image gives the possessive claim an administrative content.
Its assuming-charge image connects title to responsibility for the affair.
Its sufficiency image supplies the human claim that is explicitly shown unable to suffice.
Its accumulation-of-wealth image supplies the private holding contrasted with the focus's comprehensive title.
Its fall-into-destruction image supplies the threshold where accumulated property loses protective force.
Its gentle indication toward path and truth supplies the operative content of what is assumed 'upon us.'

structural_cues: The adjacent sequence moves from عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ to عَلَيْنَا and then لَنَا.
The preposition عَلَى marks an assumed burden in 92:12, whereas لِ marks title in 92:13.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed sufficiency, destructive falling, gentle guidance, and charge; I infer that the juxtaposed pronouns pair comprehensive title with a self-assumed guidance duty, while the live alternative treats 92:12 and 92:13 as independent assertions.

changed_reading.before: The verse announces superior property over two worlds.
changed_reading.after: It contrasts failing private property with custodial sovereignty: the one whose title spans both phases also assumes the work of indicating their paths.

context_deltas.mechanism: Fire-contact, turning away, lateral removal, and protection convert the first/later axis into a geometry of approach and withdrawal. The non-dominant focus mapping to adjacency and facing keeps this model anchored while the later context occurrence of و ل ي makes the latent orientation audible.

activation_trace.role: Its rearward image spatializes the later pole as a position behind.
Its adjacency-without-gap image turns the other pole into regulated proximity.
Its turning-toward image supplies a directional front to the focus pair.
Its meeting-the-fire-and-heat image establishes dangerous contact as one endpoint of the geometry.
Its turning-away image supplies an agentive reversal of orientation.
Its removal-to-the-side image supplies protective displacement from the contact zone.
Its warding-off-harm image gives the lateral displacement its protective function.

structural_cues: 92:15-17 moves from contact, through turning away, to being placed aside.
The same mapped و ل ي inventory is latent under the focus's ٱلْأُولَىٰ and explicit in 92:16.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rear, adjacency, facing, fire-contact, withdrawal, and lateral protection; I infer a spatial arrow from ethical orientation to eventual proximity, while the live alternative is that the sequence is moral and punitive without spatializing 92:13.

changed_reading.before: First and later are only when-events happen.
changed_reading.after: They can also mark where one is oriented within a governed field of approach, withdrawal, contact, and protective distance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Giving wealth for growth, negating a repayable favor, seeking a higher face, and awaiting satisfaction reorganize possession into a non-bilateral economy. If first and later already share one ultimate title, a human transfer need not purchase a human counter-transfer; its vector can pass through divine ownership toward deferred contentment.

activation_trace.role: Its deferral image supplies the interval between present relinquishment and later satisfaction.
Its granting-or-assigning image recasts first-phase holdings as allocations rather than absolute private title.
Its transfer-at-known-cost image supplies a transactional ledger that the following negated repayment will interrupt.
Its giving image supplies the outward transfer that begins the mechanism.
Its accumulated-wealth image identifies what is relinquished from apparent private possession.
Its growth-and-increase image makes relinquishment productive rather than merely subtractive.
Its benefaction image supplies the possible human favor whose creditor claim is denied.
Its debt-collection-and-settlement image supplies the bilateral account from which the gift is released.
Its seeking image redirects the transfer toward a non-human objective.
Its direction-and-destination image supplies the gift's reoriented vector.
Its lordship-and-ownership image identifies the comprehensive title through which the transfer is reclassified.
Its satisfaction-versus-displeasure image supplies the deferred non-monetary arrival of the sequence.

structural_cues: 92:18 gives wealth, 92:19 negates repayment of a human favor, 92:20 supplies an exclusive direction, and 92:21 defers satisfaction.
The ownership claim of 92:13 stands between failed hoarded wealth and voluntarily transferred wealth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies transfer, wealth, growth, debt settlement, direction, lordship, and deferred satisfaction; I infer that comprehensive divine title breaks the human gift out of a bilateral creditor ledger, while the live alternative is a narrower contrast between sincere and self-interested motives.

changed_reading.before: Divine ownership is a cosmic fact unrelated to the giver's transaction.
changed_reading.after: Because both present holding and later return fall within one title, giving can cease to be repayment or purchase and become a reorientation of entrusted wealth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because 92:15 foregrounds fire-contact, not a race, and the competitive branch is form-distant. It remains anchored because the focus explicitly pairs a rear/later pole with firstness and the packet supplies both rivalry in striving and the technical image of a follower behind the leader. Downstream prose should mark it as a secondary race-order resonance, never as a replacement for the fire reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's later/rear and first/precedence branches can name positions behind and ahead under the same possessive claim.

activation_trace.role: Its rearward image supplies the position of the one behind.
Its precedence image supplies the first-ranked position.
Its priority-and-superior-right image intensifies firstness as rank rather than only time.
Its rivalry-in-striving image supplies a competitive course on which positions separate.
Its runner-following-the-leader image links the rear position directly to a first-ranked predecessor.

changed_reading.before: The verse owns the first and last ages.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also levels competitive rank: both the leader and the one following behind remain inside the same ultimate claim.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a non-dominant rain branch under ٱلْأُولَىٰ and cross-connects it with remote cloud and growth images. It remains valid as an ecological resonance because the focus itself supplies later/first succession and every material link is packet-backed. Downstream prose should qualify it as a branch-distant analogy of provision, not propose 'rain' as the lexical meaning of the focus noun.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The later/first pair can carry a sequence in which a deferred rain follows an earlier one, both phases remaining under one provider's title.

activation_trace.role: Its deferred-later image supplies the interval before the following provision arrives.
Its late-rain-following-an-earlier-rain image materializes succession as a seasonal second arrival.
Its growth-and-increase image supplies the living result of successive provision.
Its heavy-rain image supplies the material intensity of provision.
Its cloud image supplies the carrier from which the rain sequence descends.

changed_reading.before: First and later are abstract epochs under ownership.
changed_reading.after: As a contained ecological analogy, they become successive provisions whose delayed arrival nourishes growth without leaving the provider's domain.

strongest_changes: The pronoun sequence around 92:11-13 changes static ownership into custodial sovereignty: failed human wealth is answered by guidance assumed as a duty and comprehensive divine title.
The mirrored easing formulas of 92:5-10 change endpoint ownership into active management of divergent, self-reinforcing routes.
Covering/disclosure and turning/side-positioning let temporal poles coexist with epistemic and spatial readings rather than forcing one chronology.
The giving sequence of 92:18-21 changes ownership into an anti-reciprocal economy in which entrusted wealth is redirected beyond a human debt ledger.
summary.what_was_special: The split inventory under ٱلْأُولَىٰ was the latent hinge: firstness coexisted with outcome, governance, charge, adjacency, turning, priority, assignment, and succession. Later context roots selectively activated those branches, producing several mechanisms without requiring them to collapse into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The governance and custodial readings depend on carrying branch potential through the possessive syntax; they may be resonance rather than direct lexical force.
The visibility and orientation models could remain structural analogies instead of semantic expansions of the focus nouns.
The race and successive-rain outliers are deliberately branch-distant and should remain marked as exploratory secondary activations.
